data.name: Hotel Leonardo Da Vinci
data.address: Málaga 194, 7550133 Las Condes, Región Metropolitana, Chile
data.description:
A 5-minute walk from the nearest metro station, this upscale hotel in a modernist building with a curved, part-glass facade is 13 km from both Santiago's central Plaza de Armas and the elegant Palacio de La Moneda.
Casual rooms feature free Wi-Fi, cable TV and minifridges. Upgraded rooms add seating areas. Room service is available.
Parking and a breakfast buffet are complimentary. Other amenities include an elegant Italian restaurant, a gym and 6 meeting rooms.
